reviews.body: Dayana is amazing! I’ve been getting my nails done with her for several years now and it’s always perfect! She’s so sweet and caring and it’s always a great experience.

reviews.author: Alina T…
reviews.body: Dayana’s place is amazing. She sterilized her equipment and has the latest colors and styles. She also cares about her clients and makes you feel comfortable. Going to get my nails done is my therapy. It’s been more than six years getting my nails done with Dayana, and hopefully, more years to come. I highly recommend her if you’re looking for a nail place.
